core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Majiid corresponds to the Arabic form مجيد (Arabic root م ج د (m-j-d); مَجِيد (Majīd)). Its core sense is glorious, majestic, noble. Majiid is Arabic مَجِيد (Majīd) 'glorious, majestic, noble', from the root م ج د (m-j-d); it is also one of the names of Allah (المجيد). The source gloss 'Exalted, Great' is broadly consistent. Same name as majed, majeed and majid.

urdu.name: مجید
urdu.long_meaning: Majiid (مجید) عربی زبان سے ماخوذ نام ہے۔ اس کا بنیادی مفہوم ماجد، مجید، شاندار ہے۔ یہ نام مسلم معاشروں میں رکھا جاتا ہے اور اس کے مفاہیم سیاق و سباق کے مطابق استعمال ہوتے ہیں۔

persian.name: مجید
persian.long_meaning: Majiid (مجید) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن ماجد، مجید، باشکوه است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

pashto.long_meaning: Majiid (مجيد) د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی نوم دی او بنسټیزه مانا یې ماجد، مجید، باوقار ده. دا نوم په مسلمانانو ټولنو کې کارول کیږي او کارونه یې د سیاق له مخې بدلیږي.

arabic.name: مجيد
arabic.long_meaning: Majiid (مجيد) اسم مأخوذ من اللغة العربية، ومعناه الأساسي الماجد، المجيد، الشريف. يُستخدم هذا الاسم في المجتمعات المسلمة ويختلف استعماله بحسب السياق اللغوي.

faq.a: Majiid is associated with the Arabic form مجيد, whose core sense is glorious, majestic, noble.

faq.q: What is the origin of Majiid?
faq.a: Majiid is associated with Arabic. Majiid is Arabic مَجِيد (Majīd) 'glorious, majestic, noble', from the root م ج د (m-j-d); it is also one of the names of Allah (المجيد). The source gloss 'Exalted, Great' is broadly consistent. Same name as majed, majeed and majid.
Yes — the underlying form مجيد is Arabic.
Majiid can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Majiid should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. False

faq.q: What does Majiid mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Majiid is rendered مجید and carries the sense ماجد، مجید، شاندار.

faq.q: What does Majiid mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Majiid is rendered مجید and carries the sense ماجد، مجید، باشکوه.
A romanized syllable approximation is ma-jiid. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Majiid?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Majiid, majiid. Script forms are مجيد, مجید, मजीद.

faq.q: Is Majiid a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
